title: ingest: SorobanInclusionFeeCharged / InclusionFeeCharged return minus the resource fee when the fee account is a muxed account

target.versions_affected: v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: SorobanInclusionFeeCharged looks up the fee account's balance changes by the muxed M address, which matches no account entry, so with a muxed fee account it and InclusionFeeCharged return 0 - resourceFee. The issue states impact low: since protocol 25 only ExtendFootprintTtl, RestoreFootprint and fee bumps with a muxed fee source are affected, none was found in about 544,000 pubnet Soroban transactions, and no caller in go-stellar-sdk, Horizon or stellar-rpc.

entries.expected: the inclusion fee charged is the same for a fee account and its muxed form
entries.observed: No conformance fact of the kit calls these helpers. By hand on v0.9.0: with fee 50000100 (resource fee 50000000) both helpers give 100 for the G fee account and -50000000 for its muxed form; the same on local stellar-core v30 ledgers with RestoreFootprint and ExtendFootprintTtl from muxed accounts.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's standalone program on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255: SorobanInclusionFeeCharged() = -50000000 and InclusionFeeCharged() = -50000000 for the muxed fee account, 100 for the same account as G; OriginalFeeCharged() = 50000100 for both.
evidence.expected_basis: Account entries, and so the fee-processing changes stellar-core writes, are keyed by the underlying G account (CAP-27); OriginalFeeCharged and SorobanResourceFeeRefund demux the fee account first.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 before filing on 2026-11-19: -50000000 for the muxed fee account.

queries: stellar/go-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01
stellar/go-stellar-sdk: the branches with commits since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6056; this record restates the public issue.
